**No** in federal court vs this site; **limited yes** (up to $7,500) at the Copyright Claims Board (CCB) only if operator is US-based & doesn't opt out.

**Timing rule (17 U.S.C. § 412):** Federal statutory damages ($750–$30k/work; up to $150k willful) + attorney's fees require effective registration:
- Before infringement begins, OR
- Within 3 mos of 1st publication.

Mid-Jan publication → 3-month window closed mid-April. B/c infringement already began, registering now won't unlock federal statutory damages or attorney's fees vs this site, even for continuing piracy.

**CCB exception (17 U.S.C. § 1504):** Late-registered works can still get up to $7,500/work ($15k/proceeding, no willfulness bump); can file w/ a pending application. Rarely viable vs pirate sites: excludes non-US respondents & allows 60-day opt-out.

**Next steps:**
- **Send DMCA takedowns now** to host, CDN, & search engines (no registration needed).
- **Register now:** secures statutory damages + attorney's fees vs *new* infringers starting post-registration, & satisfies the prerequisite to sue in federal court for actual damages, infringer profits, & injunction (17 U.S.C. § 411).
